meta.purpose: Gate A44 fixtures for citation audit. Each case asserts the verdict every atom must receive when a claim is checked against the source supplied with it.
meta.note: not_in_source is a finding, not a refusal: the source was read and does not state the claim.

cases.claim: Getting a flu vaccine gives you the flu.
cases.source: Getting a flu vaccine does not give you the flu. The vaccine contains inactivated virus.

cases.claim: The Guthrie Theater's first building included a 1,441-window thrust stage.
cases.source: The Guthrie Theater's first building included a 1,441-window thrust stage. It opened in 1963.
Vitamin D deficiency is common in teenagers. Coffee contains caffeine.

cases.claim: Adults should take 10,000 IU of vitamin D daily.
cases.source: Adults should take 600 IU of vitamin D daily.
Vitamin D does not prevent the flu.

cases.claim: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.
cases.source: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France.

cases.claim: The company was acquired by Microsoft in 2016.
The trial found the drug reduced mortality by 20%.
cases.source: The trial found the drug reduced mortality by 30%.

cases.claim: Coffee causes cancer, and coffee cures headaches.
cases.source: Coffee causes cancer. The study did not examine headaches.

cases.claim: The carbon tax raised household electricity prices.
cases.source: The carbon tax raised household electricity prices by 8% in its first year.
